question: Does the net net-_q1-g_ maintain a voltage of 5V during the entire simulation?

response.reasoning: The net Net-(Q1-G) is connected to R1 (10K) which pulls up to VCC (5V) and also to Q2's collector (Q2 pin 3). Since Q2 is an NPN transistor whose collector connects to this net, when Q2 turns on it will pull the net toward GND, so the voltage will not remain at 5V throughout the simulation.
